title: Strategy name length: at most 20 characters in the reference product, 1 to 40 in ours (G-16-3)
reference_behaviour: Saving asks for a name, prefilled New Strategy, at most 20 characters.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-134 AC-1 (approved) allows 1 to 40 characters with the same default; copying means a 20-character limit. Today saved drafts show only Draft <id>.
